name: Industry Platforms, Apps & SaaS
short: Restaurant POS, marketplaces, property management platforms, custom SaaS products, mobile apps, and managed hosting for your software.
intro: Some businesses need more than integrations: they need a platform of their own, whether that is a POS built for their restaurant, a marketplace connecting vendors and buyers, or a SaaS product to sell. These solutions cover building, launching, and running that software reliably.

solutions.name: Restaurant Point of Sale (POS) System
solutions.tagline: Order entry, tabs, kitchen display, and real-time reporting in one connected system.
solutions.text: A complete point-of-sale platform built for restaurants, cafes, and quick-service operations, covering order entry, table and tab management, and kitchen display integration in one connected system. Checkout closes out tabs and records how each guest paid (cash, card, or other) for clean bookkeeping, and it pairs with your existing card processor or terminal rather than handling card charges itself. The platform also includes menu management, role-based staff logins, and real-time reporting dashboards, giving owners and managers accurate visibility into top-selling items, average tab size, and daily revenue without reconciling numbers across separate tools. This offering includes hardware setup, menu configuration, and staff training to get your team live fast.
features: Fast ordering with modifiers, courses, and notes.
Floor plans, open tabs, and split checks.
Orders routed to the right station instantly.
Update items, prices, and availability everywhere at once.
Permissions for servers, managers, and owners.
Sales, item mix, and average tab by shift.
problems: Orders lost between the counter and the kitchen
End-of-night reconciliation takes too long
Menu changes made in several places
No clear view of what sells and when
faq: Does the POS process card payments itself?
No. It pairs with your existing card processor or terminal and records how each guest paid, which keeps payment processing flexible and bookkeeping clean.
Can it connect to delivery apps?
Yes. Orders from DoorDash, Uber Eats, and online ordering can flow into the same kitchen queue and reporting.
How long does it take to go live?
Timing depends on menu size and hardware, and includes menu configuration, hardware setup, and staff training before your first service.

solutions.name: Marketplace & Multi-Vendor Platform
solutions.tagline: Connect vendors and customers with routing, commissions, and split payouts handled automatically.
solutions.text: A multi-vendor marketplace platform for businesses connecting multiple sellers, providers, or contractors with customers through a single storefront: a local services marketplace, a multi-brand e-commerce platform, or a vendor network. The platform handles vendor onboarding and profile management, order or booking routing to the correct vendor, commission calculation, and split payouts, all without manual reconciliation. Vendors get their own dashboard for managing listings, orders, and payouts, and platform admins get oversight tools for approving vendors, resolving disputes, and monitoring marketplace-wide performance from one place.
for: Entrepreneurs launching a services or product marketplace
Associations and networks connecting members with buyers
features: Products or services searchable by category and location.
Every order sent to the right vendor automatically.
Fees calculated and payouts sent without reconciliation.
Listings, orders, reviews, and payouts in one place.
problems: Coordinating vendors by email and spreadsheets
Paying vendors manually after every sale
No way to scale beyond a handful of sellers
Disputes with no record of what happened
faq: How do split payouts work?
Using a payments platform like Stripe Connect, each customer payment is divided automatically between the vendor and the marketplace commission, and vendors are paid out on schedule.
Should we build a marketplace from scratch?
Not always. Platforms like Sharetribe can launch a marketplace quickly, and custom development makes sense when your workflows or scale require it.
Who handles vendor taxes and verification?
Payment platforms collect tax information and verify vendor identity as part of onboarding, which we configure for your marketplace.

solutions.name: Property Management Platform
solutions.tagline: Leasing, rent collection, maintenance, and owner reporting in one connected system.
solutions.text: A property management system for residential, commercial, and short-term rental operators that connects listings, applications, leases, rent collection, maintenance, and owner reporting. Applicants apply and screen online, leases are generated and e-signed, rent is collected by ACH with automatic late fees and reminders, and maintenance requests are triaged and dispatched to vendors with photos and updates sent back to tenants. Owners get monthly statements and a portal, and accounting stays reconciled by property.
features: Leases created from templates and signed online.
ACH and card payments with automatic late fees.
Tenant requests routed to vendors with status updates.
Monthly statements and documents for every owner.
Income and expenses tracked by unit and property.
problems: Chasing rent payments and late fees by hand
Maintenance requests lost in texts and calls
Owner statements built manually every month
Leases and documents scattered across folders
faq: Should we use AppFolio or Buildium or a custom system?
AppFolio and Buildium fit most residential portfolios. We implement and automate them, and build custom tools for unique workflows or integrations they do not cover.
Can tenants pay rent online automatically?
Yes. Tenants can set up autopay by ACH or card, and reminders and late fees are applied according to the lease.
How are maintenance vendors managed?
Requests are categorized and dispatched to approved vendors, who update status and upload photos and invoices for owner approval and billing.

solutions.name: Custom SaaS Product Development
solutions.tagline: Turn your expertise or internal tool into a subscription software product.
solutions.text: End-to-end development of a software-as-a-service product, from validating the idea and defining a focused first version through design, development, launch, and growth. We build secure multi-tenant applications with user accounts, roles, subscription billing, onboarding, and admin tools, on modern cloud infrastructure that scales as customers sign up. Analytics show how customers use the product, and an iterative roadmap keeps development focused on what drives retention and revenue.
for: Founders with a validated software idea
Industry experts building software for their niche
features: Users, problems, and a focused first version defined.
Sign-up, permissions, and subscriptions built in.
problems: A great idea with no technical team
An internal tool other companies want to buy
A prototype that cannot scale or be secured
Unclear what to build first
faq: How do you keep the first version from getting too big?
We define the smallest product that solves the core problem for a specific customer, launch it, and expand based on real usage rather than assumptions.
Who owns the code?
You do. We deliver the source code and infrastructure in accounts you control.
Can you run the product after launch?
Yes. Our managed SaaS service covers hosting, monitoring, security, and ongoing development.

solutions.name: Mobile App Development
solutions.tagline: iPhone and Android apps for customers or staff, connected to your existing systems.
solutions.text: Design and development of mobile apps for iPhone and Android, whether customer-facing (ordering, booking, loyalty, account management) or internal (field data collection, inspections, inventory scanning, employee communication). We build cross-platform apps that share one codebase, connect them to your CRM, ERP, and back-office systems through secure APIs, and handle app store submission, push notifications, offline support, and analytics. Ongoing updates keep the app compatible with new OS releases.
for: Brands whose customers order or book repeatedly
Field teams collecting data on site
Businesses replacing paper forms with mobile workflows
features: One codebase for iPhone and Android.
Live data from your CRM, ERP, and databases.
Work continues without a connection and syncs later.
Camera, barcode scanning, GPS, and signatures.
Submission, review, and OS compatibility handled.
problems: Customers want to order or book from their phone
Field staff fill out paper forms and retype them
Generic apps do not fit your workflow
Low engagement after the first purchase
faq: Should we build a mobile app or a mobile website?
A mobile-friendly website covers most needs. An app makes sense when customers use it often, or when you need push notifications, offline access, or device features like scanning.
Do you build for both iPhone and Android?
Yes. We typically use a cross-platform framework so one codebase serves both, reducing cost and keeping features in sync.
Who publishes the app to the app stores?
We handle submission under your developer accounts so you own the listing and the app.

solutions.name: Managed SaaS Delivery & Support
solutions.tagline: Your custom software hosted, monitored, secured, and improved, without an in-house DevOps team.
solutions.text: A subscription-based service where a business's custom software, internal tools, or automation stack is hosted, monitored, secured, and maintained on the client's behalf. This includes uptime monitoring, security patching, feature updates, technical support, and scaling infrastructure as usage grows, allowing clients to treat their internal software the same way they'd treat any other reliable SaaS product, without needing an in-house DevOps or IT team.
for: Businesses with custom software but no IT team
Companies whose original developer has moved on
Teams running critical automations that cannot fail quietly
features: Reliable infrastructure in accounts you own.
Alerts and response when something goes down.
Dependencies, servers, and certificates kept current.
Tested backups and a documented recovery plan.
A team to call for issues and improvements.
problems: Nobody maintains the custom software you depend on
Outages are discovered by customers
Security updates are years behind
Hosting costs keep climbing
faq: What does managed SaaS include?
Hosting, monitoring, security patching, backups, support, and ongoing improvements for your custom software or automations, for a predictable monthly fee.
Can you take over software another developer built?
Yes. We start with a technical review, document the system, fix urgent risks, and then bring it under ongoing management.
Do we keep ownership of our software and data?
Yes. Code, infrastructure, and data remain in accounts you own.
